sources.name: CWCheat Database Plus
sources.author: Saramagrean and the original CWCheat code authors
sources.license: Upstream terms; no blanket open-source license published
sources.notes: No explicit license for cheat data is published in the pinned upstream repository. This source is retained for provenance and link-only reference; no CWCheat-derived pack is included in the current manifest or future release archives.

sources.name: libretro-database PSP cheats
sources.author: libretro-database contributors and the original PSP cheat authors
sources.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 repository license; individual upstream code authors remain credited
sources.notes: The repository LICENSE is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Its README says cheat files are collected from web sources and user contributions, so this catalog preserves source attribution and does not relicense individual code authors rights. The whole PSP folder of the pinned revision is imported: 2513 serial packs with 75691 blocks are published, while 96 serials whose content exactly repeats another serial and 2 serials without parseable blocks are excluded.

sources.name: sashkinbro Tenchu camera patch
sources.author: sashkinbro
sources.license: Published by the pack author for the EmuCoreA cheat catalog
sources.notes: Author-provided PSP camera patch for ULES-00277 (Tenchu: Time of the Assassins [EU]), converted from the CWCheat V18.3 MODE-BYTE FIX source into the catalog pack format. The original CWCheat block names and comments are preserved, _C1/_C0 blocks become catalog blocks, and the pack is published on the cheat-catalog-3 release. ULES-00277 therefore has two catalog entries: the libretro gameplay pack and this camera pack.

sources.name: TAbdiukov PPSSPP patches
sources.author: Tim Abdiukov (TAbdiukov)
sources.notes: Exact-serial patches from the pinned author repository. Naruto includes only five non-experimental dogfight/CPU disable-restore options per regional pack; human-substitution experiments and dummy menu separators are excluded. Daxter preserves theboy181 attribution. Battlefront II US/EU share one payload verified against both source files; choose either disable or restore ticket bleeding. Each downloadable pack embeds the complete upstream license and copyright notice. Runtime not verified locally.

sources.name: Silent console cheat codes
sources.author: Adrian Zdanowicz (Silent)
sources.notes: Prototype-cheat unlock patches. One source-verified payload covers Japanese Rockstar Classics ULJM-05904; a second identical US/EU payload is shared by ULUS-10383 and ULES-01144 and published only once. Enable the patch, then enter passwords in the in-game cheat menu; see researchUrl. Every individual download embeds the complete MIT license and copyright notice. Runtime not verified locally.

sources.name: DeaTh-G Tag Force essentials
sources.author: DeaTh-G
sources.notes: Voice-only US/EU patches. Japanese audio is already present in game files; Source/Program.cs extractor concerns visual/card assets and is not needed for these blocks. Original xdelta research credited to Matheus Abreu. Reload the shop when enabling there; upstream reports title-screen voice timing limits. Other source blocks requiring extracted assets are excluded. Full MIT license is embedded in individual downloads. Runtime not verified locally.
